title: Certificates of Deposit: Customer-Wide Principal Concentration Ceiling
content:
For Certificates of Deposit, Piedmont Crescent Bank adds a customer's certificates together for exactly one purpose: to keep the money any one customer has placed in certificates under a single ceiling. This page states that ceiling and what it does and does not affect.

## The ceiling

Whenever money is to be placed into a certificate, whether as the opening deposit of a new certificate or as any later deposit into an existing one, the following test applies:

> Take the principal balances of all of the customer's certificates that are not closed, as they stand at close of business on the day in question, and add the deposit now being made. That total may be at most USD 2500000.00.

A deposit or an opening that would carry the total above USD 2500000.00 is declined in full. It is never trimmed down to the sum that would fit under the ceiling.

The test is decided on the bank's certificate records for the customer who owns, or would own, the certificate.

## What the ceiling does not do

- **No combining for pricing.** Balances of different certificates are never pooled to price a certificate. Whether the Jumbo Bonus applies depends only on the principal a single certificate holds when its term begins, so two certificates can never be added together to reach the Jumbo Bonus threshold.
- **Interest is not blocked.** Interest compounded into a certificate may lift the customer's total above USD 2500000.00; that has no consequence under this ceiling.

## Condition, judgement, outcome

| Situation (hypothetical figures) | Total after the deposit | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Open certificates total USD 2400000.00; deposit USD 100000.00 | USD 2500000.00 | Accepted: the total equals the ceiling and does not exceed it. |
| Open certificates total USD 2400000.00; deposit USD 100000.01 | USD 2500000.01 | Declined in full; not reduced to USD 100000.00. |
| Open certificates total USD 2499000.00; monthly interest compounds into one of them | above the ceiling | No effect; compounding is not a deposit tested here. |

## Points of judgement

**Does a closed certificate's old balance count?** No. Only certificates that are not closed enter the total.

**Two certificates of USD 60000.00 each (hypothetical): does either earn the Jumbo Bonus because together they pass the threshold?** No. Pooling happens only for this ceiling, never for a bonus.
